collection.title: BMW i4 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW i4 2021 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: BMW i4 2021 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
